name: Kyoto
description: The old imperial capital, unhurried — machiya guesthouses, moss gardens before the crowds, and kaiseki dinners built around the season rather than the calendar.

quickFacts.flightNote: ~11hr direct from the US West Coast

topExperiences: Dawn walk through the Fushimi Inari gates
A tea ceremony with a third-generation host
Arashiyama's bamboo grove by river boat
Nishiki Market, stall by stall, with a guide
